units: Tam. 32ᵃ מה … ויִחְיֶה what must man do in order to live (long)?; a. v. fr.—Part. חָי (v. חַי).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:6">Keth. I, 6</cite> <he>לא מפיה אנו חָיִין</he> we do not live on what comes from her lips, i.e. we do not go by her evidence. Y. ib. II, 26ᶜ bot. <he>אנו כחיין מפיה</he> we (the court) are again in the condition of dependence on her own evidence.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5:4">Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ</cite> top <he>שהן חָיִין מִמֵּי וכ׳</he> they live (draw nourishment) from the waters of last year; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5:4">ib.</cite> (<he>הוא חָיָיה</he>) <he>הוא חָיָה</he> it draws &c.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:11">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>לא חיין ולא נידונין</he> they have no share in the resurrection nor will they be judged; a. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 6a">Keth. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עד שתִּחְיֶה המכה</he> until the wound is healed up.

<cite ref="Chullin 7b:13">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>וחָיָה</he> and did recover; <he>וחָיָת</he> and it (the wound) healed up; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:2:2">Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ</cite> <he>חיתה</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:6:2">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חייתה</he>, v. <cite ref="H00495"><he>חוּת</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be recalled to life, to resurrect.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite> <he>והמתים להֵחָיוֹת</he> and the dead are destined to be revived.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90b:2">Snh. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>שעתיד להחיות</he> that he (Aaron) will resurrect.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:45">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>יְחַיֶּה את עצמו</he> let him feed himself (his passions, be selfish).
<cite ref="Yoma 71a:14">Yoma 71ᵃ</cite> <he>מְחַיֶּה חיים</he> He who sustains the living; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to recall to life, to revive. Snh. l. c. הקב״ה מְחַיֶּיה מתים the Lord revives the dead. Ib. מה שאני ממית אני מְחַיֶּה what I put to death, I revive again; a. fr.
<cite ref="H00715">same</cite>. Ib. 92ᵇ <he>מתים שה׳ יחזקאל</he> the dead whom Ezekiel revived (<cite ref="Ezekiel 37">Ez. XXXVII</cite>).
units: <cite ref="Ezekiel 37">Ib.</cite> <he>והַחֲיֵיה מתים וכ׳</he> and revive the dead in the valley of Dura; a. fr.
